behavior: Record third-party notices for the pg driver and its transitive dependencies in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md so the protected supply-chain suite's OSS-003 notice audit passes against this candidate.
nonGoals: No dependency is added, removed, upgraded or vendored: this records what the lockfile already distributes
No SBOM generator, license scanner or new tooling
No change to NOTICE, which already delegates to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
No conformance, requirement or catalog edits
No new dependencies and no network access
notes: Found by a local unsigned dry run of every catalogued G1 suite against core main 6e7a859 (informative only, never evidence). SEC-005 fails its OSS-003 notice audit with fourteen findings: pg, pg-cloudflare, pg-connection-string, pg-int8, pg-pool, pg-protocol, pg-types, pgpass, postgres-array, postgres-bytea, postgres-date, postgres-interval, split2 and xtend are distributed components with no third-party notice. The cause is ordering, not oversight: pg@8.23.0 entered the dependency tree in 743659c (HAR-003-T01, the PostgreSQL checkpointer), and the SEC-005 suite merged afterwards as structile-conformance 20ca0d3, so the suite has never once run against a candidate carrying pg. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md still lists only the G0 set. The oracle is supply-chain-audit.ts auditNotices, which takes every SBOM package marked distributed and requires noticesDocument(notices, name) to find the bare component name delimited by a non-alphanumeric character before and a non-lowercase character after, so a table row per component satisfies it; the implementation must record each component's real license rather than pad the file to match a substring. OSS-003 is catalogued at G0 with waiverPolicy never, but no G0 evidence is invalidated: the G0 suite that verifies it, OSS-001, still passes against this candidate, and the G0 gate passed against candidate 545a7664 which predates pg. It is the G1 suite SEC-005 that catches this, which is why the contract is gated G1. runnerDigest carries the attested G0 runner image digest because no G1 runner digest exists yet; task-ready v1 verifies neither digest. testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main f947e786353072ec5e6751e211c46daf06b05c39.
